dedupe_keys.name: hyderabad ev charging stations monthly consumption data

description: This dataset from the Government of Telangana, republished on the OpenCity portal, gives monthly electricity consumption of public electric vehicle charging stations in Hyderabad. The 2021 dataset page read on 2026-09-29 offers seven CSV files, one for each month from June to December 2021, and the portal shows sibling datasets for later years up to 2024. OpenCity is a civic data portal that collects data on Indian cities so that people can reuse it. Coverage is one city at station level with monthly time steps. Files are free to download and the licence shown is public domain, which the portal says meets the Open Definition. The page gives no update schedule, though it was last modified on 27 November 2025. Caveats: only energy per month is given, not sessions, power levels or occupancy, station locations may need to be joined from another source, and each year is a separate dataset. It suits capacity planning of charging infrastructure and the sizing of distribution network upgrades for electric vehicle load. No closely related catalogue record was identified in this pass.
